svg.aria-label: PostgreSQL 18 Lock-Ordering Hierarchy and Real Bugs Caught

g.text: PostgreSQL 18 Lock-Ordering Hierarchy & Real Bugs Caught
Enforced acquisition order across 10 FOR UPDATE queries, 2 advisory namespaces & 5 @Version entities — plus 6 subtle concurrency bugs proved & fixed
Color links each lock flow (left) to the real PR bug it prevents (right) — not member ownership
REQUIRES_NEW pre/post tx + per-booking isolation — never overlaps domain locks
Sorted asset IDs prevent AB/BA bundle deadlocks; scalar read bypasses L1 cache
Reservation ALWAYS locked before Asset and Transfer (#270, #319, #329)
Separate advisory namespace (2, uid) never contends with reservation quota (1, uid)
Account stays disabled if cleanup throws; instant SSE drop + 3-thread pool keeps :hb alive
6 Real Bugs One-Shot Code Misses (Proved in PRs)
Shared tx rolled back booking #1; default API methods skipped @Transactional
Fix: REQUIRES_NEW per booking + ArchUnit ban on default in ..api.. · ReassignmentRollbackIT
findById() cached enabled=true before quota lock, missing concurrent disable
Fix: scalar JPQL findActiveRoleById after lock · FindActiveRoleFreshReadIT
extend locked Asset → Res while return locked Res → Asset; transfer inverted order
Fix: unified Reservation → Asset → Transfer order · ReservationConcurrencyIT
Parallel AssetDamagedEvent + AssetRetiredEvent moved the same booking twice
Fix: expectedSourceAssetId guard under Reservation FOR UPDATE · AssetRetiredReassignmentIT
Concurrent reports on different assets bypassed the max-3 OPEN limit
Fix: advisory lock (2, reporterId) before count · IncidentQuotaConcurrencyIT
5-min sweeps blocked 20s :hb heartbeats, tripping CloudFront's 30s idle timeout
Fix: 3-thread campus-sched- pool + instant SSE drop on disable · LiveStreamIT
